# CORPHUB SOLUTION

> Single-window industrial project support partner based in Palanpur, Banaskantha District, Gujarat, India.

CORPHUB SOLUTION provides integrated industrial project support services across Gujarat and Northern India. We coordinate corporate workforce accommodation, site transportation, industrial material supply, vendor management, and corporate event logistics so project teams can focus on core engineering and construction operations.

## Services

- [Workforce Accommodation](/services/accommodation): Turnkey corporate guest houses, engineer flats, and managed workforce housing near industrial project sites in Gujarat.
- [Corporate & Site Transport](/services/transport): Daily workforce commute shuttles, executive car rentals, airport pickups, and industrial site vehicle fleets.
- [Industrial Material Supply](/services/material-supply): Sourcing and delivery of construction consumables, PPE safety gear, industrial cables, pipes, and site machinery.
- [Vendor Management & Site Liaison](/services/vendor-management): Contractor vetting, rate negotiation, SLA compliance tracking, dispute resolution, and local ground administration.
- [Corporate Event Management](/services/event-management): Turnkey execution for plant inaugurations, Bhoomi Pujan, corporate annual meets, vendor summits, and HSE safety workshops.
